response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems engineer with genuine entrepreneurial credentials (founder of GISCollective) and recent exposure to AI-agent tooling (MCP code generators), but his profile is fundamentally misaligned with this Director-level AI Strategy role. He lacks recognized AI expertise, an AI-related advanced degree, cloud platform strategy experience, and any track record advising strategic customers/partners — all core requirements for this position.
strengths: 20-year track record spanning web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure engineering across many domains
Entrepreneurial background as founder/maintainer of an open-source geo-data platform (GISCollective)
Current hands-on exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
concerns: No evidence of recognized AI expertise or demonstrated AI products/platforms at scale, unlike the 'preferred' bar for this role
No experience advising strategic external customers/partners on cloud or AI adoption — a core job responsibility
Career trajectory and titles (Senior/Staff Developer) don't match the Director-level, strategic IC scope of a Principal Engineer AI Strategy role, and cloud-specific depth is minimal

key_factors.factor: Broad engineering experience and entrepreneurial founder background
